verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator. Versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automation definitions such as simulation scenarios, configuration scripts, or plugin setups is a conceivable axis for it, but the evidence documents no such capability. Editable SDF files and configuration scripts only allow user-side workarounds like external source control, which earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
